title: Your journey into the world of AGI solutions starts here
description: We invite you on a journey into the world of AGI solutions built on blockchain technology, and beyond. You bring the idea, Fractera AGI does the rest.

blocks.title: Your journey into the world of AGI solutions starts here
blocks.description: Not just a site template. It quickly grows into what you need: an agent that solves your tasks, an application, or automation of your business processes. You decide. All you bring is the idea; Fractera AGI does the rest.

blocks.text: The AGI and web3 core installs on your computer in seconds, and your site is live on the internet at a temporary address right away. Your own domain takes a couple of minutes more. Need a server? Rent a VPS and move in ten minutes.
Tell the agent your idea. It asks a few sharp questions and builds the project on the Fractera starter for Next 16, an architecture made for heavy load from day one, with nothing to rebuild later.
Your knowledge graph already holds thousands of proven skills, plugins and MCP servers, chosen on the advice of leading AI developers. The agent finds the right one the moment it is needed.
Take any ready solution and make it stronger with your own experience and craft. That makes a digital product with real value. We find buyers for it, and a smart contract guarantees every deal.

You come with an idea and tell it to your agent. It builds the product from skills and other people's expertise. Use it yourself or sell it: buyers find you through the AGI network, and you move on to the next idea.
A built-in database, sign-in with user roles and dozens of other solutions. All of their code is open right inside your application: fix it, improve it or remove it. It is up to you.

landing.claim: From idea to enterprise product, 99% faster

landing.closingTitle: Your idea is the only thing missing
landing.closingText: Use Claude Code, start building and describe what you want. The rest is already here.

items.text: New project. Anna is opening «Strand», a hair salon on Garden Street. Assembling a team of agents.
I need online booking, a client base and an assistant that answers at night too.
Got it. Searching the AGI network for ready solutions: booking, CRM, an AI consultant.
items.title: The registrar looks for solutions
steps: Looking for booking modules for salons
Comparing three CRMs by reviews and price
Checking which authors accept payment by contract

items.text: There is a booking module for salons: stylist slots, Telegram reminders. Connecting over a2a.
Taking the client base: visit history, favourite stylist, a gift on the fifth visit.
Terms are ready. Drafting an m2m contract on the blockchain: module authors are paid on acceptance.
Terms checked. Signing the smart contract on Anna's behalf.
items.title: Sign the smart contract on Anna's behalf?

items.text: External check: booking passes its tests, client data is encrypted. Confirmed.
items.title: External validator check

items.text: I have learned the price list and the stylists' hours. Ready to answer clients at 3 a.m.
The site is built on the Fractera template and the domain is connected. Contract fulfilled, authors paid.
Three bookings for tomorrow already. That was faster than choosing paint for the walls.
Done. What is your next idea?
